:::{#rem-noise-conditional-covariates}
#### The noise depends on which covariates it is conditional on

The covariate $\Predvar$ in the definition of the [noise](#def-noise) can be a vector of several [covariates](#def-covariate).
The noise is defined only once the covariates in $\Predvar$ are chosen.
Adding a [covariate](#def-covariate) to $\Predvar$ changes the [mean function](#def-mean-function) $\truemean$,
so it changes the noise of the same [observation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-observation).

:::
